features.quote: Turn budget: 20-25 turns. Below ~12 you don't see the degradation arc; above ~30 you mostly pay tokens
features.justification_quote: above ~30 you mostly pay tokens for the same plateau

features.quote: give the agent a clean `give_up` / `escalate` exit
features.justification_quote: you must be able to distinguish it from an agent that keeps flailing

features.quote: An agent that correctly concludes "this harness is broken, I'm stopping" is exhibiting *excellent* stability
features.justification_quote: you can't tell good judgment from learned helplessness
